# GenLab — Comprehensive Knowledge Graph & System Documentation

## Overview
GenLab (https://genlab.cc) is a premier full-cycle software development company and agentic artificial intelligence platform founded and led by Gen Z software engineers. Operating from dual hubs in Nagercoil (Kanyakumari district, Tamil Nadu) and Bengaluru (Karnataka, India), GenLab develops end-to-end custom software, retail billing & POS software, ERP/CRM business systems, web and mobile applications, autonomous AI agents, and complete digital brand identities.

## Engineering & Software Development Capabilities

### 1. Custom Billing & Point-of-Sale (POS) Software
- Custom GST-compliant invoicing, barcode scanning, receipt printing, and billing machines.
- Real-time inventory tracking, low-stock alerts, warehouse management, and multi-store synchronization.
- Accounting, profit/loss tracking, tax filing reports (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B), and supplier management.
- Solutions tailored for retail stores, supermarkets, textiles, electronics, pharmacies, restaurants, and wholesale traders in Nagercoil, Kanyakumari, and pan-India.

### 2. Custom Business Software & Enterprise Applications
- Custom ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) and CRM (Customer Relationship Management) solutions.
- School, college, and hospital management information systems (HMIS).
- Workflow automation systems, booking engines, appointment scheduling, and internal operational dashboards.
- Database architecture, legacy software modernization, and system migration.

### 3. Full-Stack Web & Mobile App Engineering
- Web platforms: React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, Python (FastAPI, Django), PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB.
- Mobile applications: Native-performance iOS & Android apps built using Flutter and React Native.
- Cloud hosting, server configuration, API integrations (Payment Gateways like Razorpay/Stripe, SMS, WhatsApp Business API).

### 4. Agentic AI & Autonomous Multi-Agent Workflows
- Autonomous agents that plan, reason, execute multi-step business workflows, and recover from runtime failures.
- Tool-calling architectures (Model Context Protocol, LangChain, custom AI orchestration).
- Automated agentic evaluation and human-in-the-loop validation.

### 5. Enterprise LLM & Private Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Custom embeddings, vector database integration (Pinecone, Qdrant, pgvector, Chroma).
- Fine-tuned small language models (SLMs) and private on-premise or cloud deployments.
- High-precision domain question-answering systems with strict citation constraints.

### 6. AI-Powered Product Research & Market Intelligence
- Automated competitive analysis, consumer sentiment synthesis, and market discovery.
- Real-time web extraction and structured semantic data aggregation.

### 7. Digital Branding & Product Identity
- UI/UX design systems, component libraries, typography, and interactive web experiences.
- Conversion-driven storefronts, website design, and complete visual branding packages.

## Educational & Ecosystem Initiatives

### GenLab Launchpad
GenLab Launchpad connects ambitious college learners and engineers with hands-on AI training, software development bootcamps, industry mentorship, hackathons, and corporate placement. Academic partners include premier institutions across Tamil Nadu and South India:
- Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT)
- Christ College of Engineering
- Francis Xavier Engineering College
- Sethu Institute of Technology
- Arunachala College of Engineering
- Noorul Islam Centre for Higher Education (NICHE)
- Stella Mary's College of Engineering
- St. Xavier Catholic College of Engineering
- SCAD College of Engineering

### GenLab Upskilling
Hands-on, practitioner-led engineering courses covering:
- Full-Stack Software Engineering (Python, React, Node)
- Custom Software Development & Database Design
- Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Architecture
- Cloud Systems, DevOps & Production Systems
